description: This file defines an abstract base class for UI tests in a Selenium WebDriver testing framework, providing setup and teardown methods, as well as utility assumptions for test execution conditions.

classes.name: BaseUiTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for UI Selenium tests that provides setup and teardown functionalities, with support for different run modes and environment configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes configuration and WebDriver before each test, based on whether the run mode requires secrets.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver after each test if it was initialized.

methods.name: assumeRealMode
methods.description: Skips the test execution if the system is in discovery-only mode, ensuring tests only run in real mode.
